sharedRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability, until the start of your next Command phase:
  - Select one (each can be chosen once per battle):
    - Assault Doctrine: When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, this unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.
    - Devastator Doctrine: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [ASSAULT].
    - Tactical Doctrine: When this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, this unit is eligible to shoot even if it Fell Back this turn; this unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Fell Back this turn.

sharedRules.name: Special Move Types
sharedRules.description:
Shock Disembark Move (the Shock mode of a Disembark move):
  - A unit can make this move only if this unit is embarked and the Transport this unit is embarked within is on the battlefield and this unit did not embark this phase.
  - After it moves, until the end of the turn, this unit cannot declare a charge.
Assault Disembark move (the Assault mode of a Disembark move):
  - Each model is set up wholly within 3" of that Transport.
  - A unit can make this move only if this unit is embarked and the Transport this unit is embarked within is on the battlefield and this unit did not embark this phase and not (the Transport this unit is embarked within advanced this phase or the Transport this unit is embarked within fell back this phase).
